## The problem

What can't you do today? What's the FinOps / attribution workflow this
would unblock?

## The proposed feature

What you'd like CostDNA to do.

## Why it fits CostDNA's scope

CostDNA is deliberately scoped as the **inferred-tags input layer** —
it infers ownership of untagged resources and writes tags back, so
existing FinOps tools work on 100% of spend. Features that fit this
wedge move fast; features that turn CostDNA into "another dashboard"
get discussed first. Where does this land?

## Alternatives you've considered

Other tools, manual workarounds, etc.

## Would you use it / build it?

- [ ] I'd use this if it existed
- [ ] I'd be willing to contribute the implementation
- [ ] I'm running CostDNA on a real account and this is blocking me
